item.title: The Bronze Age Collapse Took Fifty Years. Nobody Living Through It Knew.
item.description: Around 1177 BCE the eastern Mediterranean world ended in a fifty-year multi-causal cascade. The contemporaneous textual record does not appear to recognize it. The pattern of how cascades hide from their inhabitants is the genuinely uncomfortable lesson — and we are almost certainly in at least one right now.
